attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 15
attributes.name: World Wave
attributes.powers:
At the end of any player's turn, discard this card to move any number of characters at your location to another location. Ignore movement restrictions.

For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill + 2d12.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 17 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
